<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Flowcatalyst\Events\Solo\Domain\Aggregate;

final readonly class UnknownEventData
{
    public function __construct(
        public string $status,
        public ?int $level,
        public mixed $mode,
        public string $kind,
        public ?string $version,
        public ?string $flag,
    ) {}

    /** @param array<string, mixed> $data */
    public static function fromArray(array $data): self
    {
        return new self(
            status: $data['status'],
            level: $data['level'],
            mode: $data['mode'],
            kind: $data['kind'],
            version: $data['version'],
            flag: $data['flag'],
        );
    }

    /** @return array<string, mixed> */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'status' => $this->status,
            'level' => $this->level,
            'mode' => $this->mode,
            'kind' => $this->kind,
            'version' => $this->version,
            'flag' => $this->flag,
        ];
    }
}
